create_SpectralBiclustering: create a SpectralBiclustering model to find checkerboard-structure biclusters in a matrix
create_SpectralCoclustering: create a SpectralCoclustering model to cluster rows and columns with block-diagonal bicluster structure
run_SpectralBiclustering_fit: run SpectralBiclustering fit on a matrix with bistochastic normalization and k-means clustering
run_SpectralCoclustering_fit: run SpectralCoclustering fit on a matrix with scale normalization and k-means clustering
test_SpectralBiclustering_log_normalize: test log normalization for biclustering on dense nonnegative matrices
